segments.text: THy worde is a Lanterne vnto my feete: and a light vnto my pathes.
I haue ſworne, and am ſtedfaſtlye purpoſed: to kepe thy righteous iudgementes.
I am troubled aboue meaſure: quicken me, O Lorde, according vnto thy woorde.
Let the free will offerynges of my mouth pleaſe thee, O Lorde: and teache me thy iudgementes.
My ſoule is alway in my hande: yet doe not I forget thy lawe.
The vngodlye haue layed a ſnare for me: but yet ſwarued not I from thy commaundementes.
Thy teſtimonies haue I claymed as myne heritage for euer: and why? they are the very ioye of my heart.
I haue applyed my heart to fulfill thy ſtatutes alwaye: euen vnto the ende.
As it was in the beginning. &c.
